title: State migration and preflight checks for storage TF module (EBS/EFS/S3) with encryption-first defaults
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a resilient Terraform module and an upgrade/migration playbook for storage primitives used in Private/VPC deployments: EBS volumes, EFS filesystems, and S3 buckets. The module must enforce encryption-by-default (KMS CMKs or provider-managed AES), provide safe snapshot lifecycle policies, support idempotent stateful upgrades, and include preflight health checks and automated snapshot-restore smoke tests as part of CI/CD. This ticket covers design decisions, implementation of migration helpers (import scripts and migration TF), Terraform plan-time drift detection hooks, and integration with monitoring (CloudWatch/Datadog) for health probes.
tasks: Design public module API: inputs for kms_key_id, default_encryption_mode, snapshot_retention_days, cross_account_replication
Implement tf module resources with opt-out knobs but encryption default enabled
Add lifecycle rules for S3 with mandatory encryption tag enforcement and snapshot lifecycle for EBS/EFS
Write import and state-migration helper scripts to safely adopt existing resources during module upgrades
Add preflight plan hook that runs a dry-run terraform plan and a validation script to detect destructive changes
Implement a terratest suite that does create->snapshot->restore for EBS/EFS and verifies object encryption in S3
Add CloudWatch metrics and Datadog monitors for snapshot age, failed snapshot jobs, and encryption misuse
Create runbook and rollout plan with canary pattern and automatic rollback criteria
acceptance_criteria: Module defaults to encryption enabled for all resource types and exposes a single KMS input
Upgrade path can import existing resources with zero data loss in test runs (validated in terratest)
Preflight plan hook blocks merges that would delete snapshots or turn off encryption without explicit opt-in
CI runs snapshot-restore smoke tests in a sandbox and reports pass/fail to the PR
Monitoring alerts trigger if last snapshot age > snapshot_retention_days or if KMS key not applied
Docs and runbook published: migration steps, manual rollback, and required IAM roles
comments: 2026-03-10 Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after infra retro. Primary goal is to avoid disruptive upgrades when customers enable Private deployments.
2026-03-11 Liam Wong: Drafted public API for module, leaning toward single_kms_key input with per-resource overrides. Will post design doc link.
2026-03-12 Security review scheduled. Raised question around cross-account snapshot copy permission scope for enterprise customers.
2026-03-13 Engineering sync: Agreed to implement plan-time blocker that fails CI when plan removes kms_key_id or sets encryption to false unless explicit migration flag is present.
2026-03-14 Liam Wong: Started terratest harness; initial EBS snapshot->restore passed in AWS test account. Next: weave in S3 encryption object checks and EFS restoration flow.
notes: Trade-offs considered: 1) Force-encryption vs opt-out: decided on encryption-by-default with explicit opt-out and documented migration steps because changing live customer encryption flags is high risk. 2) State migration helpers vs manual terraform import: provide opinionated scripts to handle large fleets and tag-based adoption to reduce human error. 3) Snapshot retention default set to 14 days with a clear opt-in for longer retention to control cost. Rollout strategy: create beta with a single customer, run canary over two weeks, then enable default in module v2 and deprecate legacy modules.
